questions.subject: Social Science
questions.stem:
Consider the following statements.
1. Rohan is told that the market demand for mangoes at a given price is worked out by adding up what every potential buyer wants to buy at that price.
2. Rohan answers that market demand is simply the quantity one single consumer wants to buy at different prices.
Select the correct option. (A) Both 1 and 2 are true and 1 explains 2. (B) Both 1 and 2 are true but 1 does not explain 2. (C) Statement 1 is true but statement 2 is false. (D) Both statements 1 and 2 are false.

answerScheme.modelAnswer: Statement 1 is true but statement 2 is false.
